# Cherry Spices — G4 *Friendship is Magic*

Cherry Spices is a brown unicorn mare with a deep red/magenta mane, green eyes, and two cherries for a cutie mark. You might recognize her in the crowds at the Crystal Empire's Equestria Games. Her baking hobby comes from Hasbro's collector cards, not from dialogue in the show. She is distinct from the similarly cherry-marked Cherry Berry. [Character and appearance reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Cherry_Spices).

**Name and history.** *Cherry Spices* is an official **merchandise name**, not a nickname invented by fans: Hasbro's first-wave mystery figure was #17 (2010 European release; later U.S. distribution). Its collector card describes her as inventing baking recipes. The Wave 6 reissue, #14, changed the toy's pose and coloring. Comic artist Andy Price reportedly said blind-bag selections led to her inclusion in the licensed IDW comic. These sources establish her merchandise identity, but the show does not introduce her by name. [Collector-card descriptions](https://www.strawberryreef.com/Index/g4characters.html) · [Wave 1 figure details](https://data.mlpmerch.com/blind-bags/details/1w17/).

**Speaking / continuity.** She is a silent background character in the G4 animated series, with **no verified individual voice actor or alter ego**. She also appears in licensed IDW comics (a separate storytelling medium); the toy's baker description does not establish an on-screen job. Other background appearances include *The Cutie Re-Mark – Part 1*, *On Your Marks*, *Newbie Dash*, *The Fault in Our Cutie Marks*, *Rock Solid Friendship*, *Parental Glideance*, *Yakity-Sax*, and *The Washouts*.

## Important moments

Cherry Spices has **no documented character-defining speech or major decision**. These are her clearest identifiable appearances, rather than a personal story arc:

- **First TV appearance — “Equestria Games” (S4E24).** She joins the opening ceremony and later appears in the stadium audience: the clearest way to spot the merchandise-named pony in animation. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w5tPOH4MBu4) (precise scene timestamp unavailable).
- **A later musical cameo — “Growing Up Is Hard to Do” (S9E22).** She appears aboard the Friendship Express during “Being Big Is All It Takes,” showing the background design was still in use in the final season. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=33zZ46Tp28A) (precise scene timestamp unavailable).

**Comics note.** In the licensed *Friendship is Magic* **issue #9**, page 21, she watches Hay's Hardware catch fire after a Cutie Mark Crusaders' stray firework; this predates her animated debut. [Issue publication and creator credits](https://data.mlpmerch.com/comic-covers/issue/9/) (Katie Cook, writer; Andy Price, art).
